PSE 390: Week 9 Ethics and Public Quiz (10pt) is CLOSED. It was due and locked Sat Nov 7 11:59pm MT. Nothing was submitted because the runner Mac was offline Nov 3 to Nov 10.

Live Canvas check today: lock passed, still unsubmitted. It cannot be submitted now without a teacher-side reopen.

TA-first is blocked: the only TA on the roster is Ernest Elliott, and Canvas exposes no email address for him. Canvas Inbox is the usual route, but it needs to run from the Mac.

Your call: say yes and I will email Professor Tellez (gabi_tellez@byu.edu is not verified, so I would use the Canvas-Inbox route from the Mac instead) asking to reopen Week 9 or accept a late submission. I will not contact a professor without your explicit yes.

Everything else in PSE 390 is on track: Week 10 quiz due Sat Nov 14, and the Participation Quizzes (11.10 today 3:30pm, 11.12 Thursday, and the rest) are in-class and yours.
